overview: Freshwater West – 'Fresh West' to locals – is almost a mile of sand on the exposed west coast of the Castlemartin peninsula, south of Milford Haven, reached along the B4319. Behind it lie the big dune systems of Broomhill and Gupton Burrows. At the southern end, the rocky outcrop of Little Furznip, topped by a thatched seaweed-drying hut, separates it from Frainslake Bay.

This is widely seen as Wales's most consistent surf beach, and it has hosted the Welsh National Surfing Championships. It is also a serious place. Strong currents and heavy waves make it unsuitable for bathing, and the tidal range is around 6.5 metres, so the beach changes a great deal through the day. There's no village, just car parks, toilets and Café Môr, which trades from the southern car park from spring to early autumn.

You may recognise the setting from films. The beach appeared in Ridley Scott's Robin Hood and in Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows, where Shell Cottage was built at the foot of the dunes. The dunes, cliffs and the land inland form part of a protected coastline, home to chough, waders and grey seals.

text: Freshwater West faces west into the Atlantic and picks up almost every swell that reaches this coast, so there is usually something here when other Pembrokeshire beaches are flat. Shifting sandbanks along the beach give a range of peaks, with rocky sections towards the ends.

That exposure is also its problem: it is often too big or blown out. It is at its best in light easterly winds and on the smaller days of a swell. Strong currents run along the beach, and the waves can break hard close to shore. If it is maxed out, try more sheltered south-coast beaches such as Freshwater East or Manorbier.

Freshwater West is the famous one. The beach has a low headland to the south with a right over reef, and fast hollow sandbar waves in the middle at low tide in front of the Furzenip rocks. South-west swell, north-east offshore, and a rising tide are best, and autumn is the pick of the year. It works from two to six feet and attracts a moderate crowd with a relaxed lineup.

Be careful: the main beach is rippy at any size, there's a strong north-south current on the drop, quicksand at low tide at the north end, uneven rock in the middle, and weaverfish. The south end lies within the Castlemartin firing range, so don't cross the fence. There's a free car park and some roadside parking, toilets and camping nearby.

cards.label: Level
cards.title: Intermediate to advanced
cards.text: Not a beach for learners on their own. Go with a school that chooses the day and the spot.

cards.label: Conditions
cards.title: Any west/south-west swell
cards.text: The most consistent spot in the area. Light easterly winds are offshore.

cards.label: Hazards
cards.title: Strong currents and powerful waves
cards.text: Currents and swell make it unsuitable for bathing. Stay out unless you are a competent surfer, and use the flags when lifeguards are on duty.

practical.label: Parking
practical.title: Car parks above the beach
practical.text: Parking is limited and gets crowded when the surf is good. Postcode SA71 5AH.

practical.label: Facilities
practical.title: Toilets and Café Môr
practical.text: Toilets on site. Café Môr trades from the southern car park from spring to early autumn.

practical.label: Lifeguards
practical.title: Summer service
practical.text: A lifeguard station has run in summer since 2010. Check RNLI dates.

practical.label: Dogs
practical.title: Allowed all year
practical.text: Dogs are allowed on the beach all year.

practical.label: Firing range
practical.title: Castlemartin range
practical.text: The MoD Castlemartin range lies close by. Firing can be loud, so obey all signs and red flags on the coast path.

faqs.q: Is Freshwater West safe for swimming?
faqs.a: No. Strong currents and swell make it unsuitable for bathing. It is a surfing beach for competent surfers.

faqs.q: Where was Shell Cottage from Harry Potter?
faqs.a: It was a set built at the foot of the dunes at Freshwater West for Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows, and later removed.

faqs.q: Are dogs allowed at Freshwater West?
Is there a lifeguard at Freshwater West?
faqs.a: Yes, in the summer months. A lifeguard station has run there since 2010.

faqs.q: Can I surf the south end of Freshwater West?
faqs.a: Only when the range is open. It lies inside the Castlemartin MOD range, so check the firing times and never cross the fence when it is closed.
